Base de gestion (export du 12.11.2026) : au moins 1 jour avant le départ ; le jour du départ ou no show : aucun remboursement, facturation totale.

notes: URL /transfers/ : page d'orientation créée le 11.11.2026 (demande de Jérémy) : minivan privé (pages /taxi/, VIP Taxi Lanta), minivan partagé (autre prestataire, demande WhatsApp de Secret Travel & Tour), songthaew sur Koh Lanta (/taxi/songthaew/). Le speedboat garde son URL /tours/speedboat/.

Minivan partagé : aucun tarif ni nom du prestataire sur le site, jamais présenté comme VIP Taxi Lanta (décision de Jérémy du 11.11.2026, qui remplace celle du 10.11.2026 « rien sur le site »). Prix sur WhatsApp seulement.

Faits des trois choix : taxiRoutes.json (privé, 6 à 8 places, sans partage), taxi.json et songthaew.json (songthaew pour le groupe seul), terms.njk art. 5 et 9 (partagé : arrêts possibles, le chauffeur peut ne pas attendre).

faq.q: What is the difference between a private and a shared minivan?
faq.a: A private minivan is for your group only. A shared minivan carries other passengers too, so it may stop to pick them up or drop them off. The driver may not be able to wait for you.

faq.q: How much does a shared minivan cost?
faq.a: Send your route and date on WhatsApp and we reply with the price.

faq.q: Which one is the taxi on Koh Lanta?
faq.a: On Koh Lanta the taxis are songthaews: pickup trucks with a roof and two benches in the back. You can book one for your group only.

faq.q: Can I get a child seat?
faq.a: Child and baby seats are on request, and only if we confirm them in writing.

private.title: Private minivan across Southern Thailand
private.text: A minivan for your group only, between airports, piers, national parks and towns. It seats 6 to 8 depending on luggage. No sharing, no waiting for other passengers.

shared.title: Shared minivan
shared.text: Seats in a minivan with other passengers, arranged by Secret Travel & Tour with a local transport partner. It may stop to pick up or drop off other passengers. The driver may not be able to wait for you.
shared.ask: Send your route, the date and your group size. We reply with the price.

local.title: Local taxi (songthaew) on Koh Lanta
local.text: On the island the taxis are songthaews, pickup trucks with a roof and two benches in the back. You can book one for your group only.

unsure.title: Not sure which one fits?
unsure.text: Tell us where you are going and when. We point you to the right one.
